findings.title: DF discovery repair leaves existing undated queue entries unchanged
findings.cause: PendingQueue.discover skips an existing fingerprint before refreshing raw date/evidence/lane; repaired discovery alone cannot recover the same queued item.

replay.test_scope: isolated duplicate rediscovery, not real collector execution

closure_criteria: Recover affected existing candidates without rewriting original capture evidence; preserve audit trail and prevent duplicates.
Show date provenance, actual processing outcome and history/feed presence or specific justified rejection for this URL.
Demonstrate new and already-queued items; recompute lane using trustworthy original timing, not by forcing everything LIVE.

findings.title: Audit executor reports live success although the only live test was skipped
findings.cause: test_beta_source_runtime_fast.py skips when OPENAI_API_KEY is unavailable; executor records successful step exit as LIVE_OUTCOME success.

evidence.note: Workflow definition originates from main, but logs explicitly checkout staging; inspected read-only as staging execution evidence.

closure_criteria: Skipped/not-run must remain explicit and must not refresh a live-validation success timestamp.
Prove actual source fetch execution and newer per-source artifacts; no credential disclosure or unnecessary AI dependency for read-only discovery.

findings.title: Two consecutive recovery attempts fail applying generated patches
findings.cause: git apply --check rejects malformed patch at lines 9 and 10; validation and successful repair commit are skipped.
closure_criteria: Bound retries by failure signature; validate patch format before applying.
Produce a useful reviewed staging change or exact blocker and continue an independent task; demonstrate transition without owner restart.

findings.title: Beta fast validation supplies no end-to-end publication evidence
findings.cause: beta_source_engine_fast.main only discovers and always records new=0,published=0,rows=[],pending=0,rejected=0. It never evaluates these items for publication and can label them ok.

evidence.pulso_caveat: Pulso is now implemented in core but has no post-repair discovery artifact; do not infer new integration failure from old health.

closure_criteria: Separate discovery-only status from evaluated publication outcomes.
Provide URL-level discovery, pending/seen/rejection, dates and history/feed reconciliation or exact blockage.

findings.title: Latest staging QA blocks preview and reviewer
findings.cause: Snapshot normative test expects at least 12 visible normative rows; actual current snapshot has 11. This is an assertion failure, not by itself evidence that a required article was omitted.
closure_criteria: Explain the 11-vs-12 change against editorial decisions and fixed contract fixtures.
Restore meaningful QA; do not insert content or weaken assertion only to turn the workflow green.

findings.title: Published Bupa summary treats completed opening/acquisition as future
findings.cause: History and feed use future tense for La Dehesa opening and Huinganal purchase while publisher body describes operating since previous month and a recent acquisition.

evidence.what_is_verified: US$15 million amount and three-project scope agree. Opening/acquisition lifecycle does not. Mindplace remains a future expansion.
evidence.queue_conflict: A separately fingerprinted listing instance is rejected processor_rejected; this is not proof the story is absent.

closure_criteria: Committee reconciles lifecycle of each project against original and preserves source/date; independent reviewer checks resulting history/feed.

findings.title: Pulso/La Tercera connector excludes Nacional articles by construction
findings.cause: CuratedBetaSourceScout restricts listing to canal/pulso and path to /pulso/noticia/; two verified Nacional stories cannot be captured by this source path.

evidence.budget_overlap: 4.7% headline is already in MINSAL history/feed dated 2026-10-01; do not count the entire event as missing or duplicate-publish. Incremental interpretation requires editorial review.

closure_criteria: Document promised scope vs actual sections; add approved capture route or explicit coverage exclusion.
Reconcile these URLs with existing cross-source events and publish only incremental value.

findings.title: PMO ready label lacks current independent release qualification
findings.cause: PMO closed_beta.status remains ready and updated_at 2026-09-29 despite latest QA failure and open source/editorial gates in issue #5.
closure_criteria: Retain historical validation provenance, but make current blocked/unvalidated assessment visible and bind to reviewed SHA.
Do not reuse historical ready label as evidence of present editorial readiness.
